experiment: E64 frozen 20-class migration of E58 and one-shot Test engineering audit
authorization: User explicitly authorized one frozen Test engineering audit before all Train gates pass; this is not a Train-gate pass claim.

identity_migration.source: E54 ten inner OE-EEGNet models; E58 identity component
identity_migration.procedure: Freeze each generic encoder, discard its eight-class prototypes/radii, build normalized class-mean embedding prototypes from all 20 subjects using fit blocks only, then equally average the ten 20-class cosine score vectors.
identity_migration.batch_rule: MAT files are read one by one; GPU batching is only for acceleration and every preprocessing/feature/score operation is trial-local. No batch statistics are permitted.

decision.rule: dr >= tau_high -> logSPD identity; tau_low <= dr < tau_high -> averaged OE-EEGNet identity; dr < tau_low -> 0
decision.threshold_source: E64 final20 calibration clean-known logSPD distance_ratio only

test_audit.timing: Only after every prediction and e64_predictions.csv have been written, read Test session for offline audit.
test_audit.sample_order: Brainprint_Competition/test.csv Sample order; test_metadata supplies sample-aligned MAT paths only.

reporting.e58_inner_reference: Read-only reference from E58 results/report; E64 does not rerun E58 inner evaluation.
reporting.train_auc: N/A for final20 fit/calibration/sanity because all 20 Train subjects are registered and no pseudo-unknown set is used.
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train Session1 continuous-block proxies only; final20 sanity is not cross-session evidence. Test session audit is descriptive, not ground-truth scoring. No claim that Train gates have passed.
